descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The (Mechanical) Engineering Manager is responsible for managing a team of mechanical engineers, overseeing the design and development of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures the implementation of engineering strategies and influences technical practices. This job profile is intended for People Managers of more senior expert-level employees (P20–P40, M20). Activities in charge:
• Manage the team that performs hydraulic and functional tests for centrifugal pumps
• Ensure that area safety guidelines are met
• Attention and follow-up with clients to provide technical support
• Implementation of continuous improvement projects
• Development of strategies for cost reduction, optimization, and productivity
• KPI's management
• Collaborate with the company's vision to achieve objectives Requirements:
• Bachelors in engineering.
• Experience in metalworking, electrical, electronics.
• +5 years in management roles
• Previous experience in rotodynamic equipment
• Knowledge of Lean and problem-solving tools
• Strong leadership
• Customer and result oriented
• Fluent English What we offer you We offer:
• Benefits Over law
• Saving found
• Training
• Christmas bonus over low
• Development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
